project: Weave Self-Iteration US-444 Core Gate Hardening
description: Small Ralph self-iteration for the current branch. The previous PRD belonged to `ralph/self-iteration-20260519-064313` and all stories were passing, so it was archived under `scripts/ralph/archive/self-iteration-20260519-073710/`. No PR CI auto-fix context was present. GitHub CI health at kickoff: latest main CI run 26066339689 was green, previous PR #24 CI run 26065939378 was green, and the earlier main CI run 26064673112 was green. Local inspection showed the known fresh-CI embed risk is covered by `cmd/server/embed_ci_bdd_test.go` plus `cmd/server/web/embed-placeholder.txt`, and the US-453 streamless binary response risk has targeted coverage in `ComplianceReportsPage.test.tsx`. This PRD focuses on remaining US-444 full-stack probes that still treat wired OSv2 service regressions as skips.

userStories.name: Make US-444 aggregate gate reject unwired aggregation APIs
userStories.description: Strengthen the aggregate Playwright probe so a reachable full-stack backend must expose the object aggregation endpoint instead of skipping when aggregation is missing or unavailable.
bdd_acceptance: Given the US-444 suite runs against a reachable full-stack backend, When `us444/03-aggregate.spec.ts` posts a count aggregation for the seeded customer ObjectType, Then 404, 503, and other non-OK responses fail the test instead of calling `test.skip`.
Given the aggregate response succeeds, When the response is decoded, Then the spec asserts a non-empty numeric metrics payload and validates the aggregate result is greater than or equal to zero.
Given Playwright runs in list-only CI discovery, When the aggregate spec is parsed, Then its scenario remains discoverable and contains no `test.skip` or `test.fixme` guards.

userStories.name: Make US-444 PITR gates reject unwired dataset history APIs
userStories.description: Strengthen the PITR Playwright probes so a reachable full-stack backend must expose dataset history and rollback validation routes rather than skipping empty 404 route misses.
bdd_acceptance: Given the US-444 suite runs against a reachable full-stack backend, When `us444/14-pitr.spec.ts` requests history for an unknown dataset RID, Then an empty 404 route miss fails instead of being skipped.

Given rollback is requested without the required `to` query parameter, When the response is decoded, Then the route must return a structured 4xx validation or not-found envelope rather than an empty unwired response.
Given Playwright runs in list-only CI discovery, When the PITR spec is parsed, Then its scenarios remain discoverable and contain no `test.skip` or `test.fixme` guards.

userStories.name: Make US-444 browse and identity gates reject unwired core APIs
userStories.description: Strengthen the browse and role-management Playwright probes so the full-stack seed and identity surfaces are required when the backend is reachable.
bdd_acceptance: Given the US-444 suite runs against a reachable full-stack backend, When `us444/02-browse.spec.ts` requests seeded customer objects, Then non-OK responses and empty seeded customer pages fail instead of skipping.
Given the US-444 suite runs against a reachable full-stack backend, When `us444/15-role-mgmt.spec.ts` requests `/api/v2/me`, Then non-OK responses fail and the response must contain a roles array.

Given Playwright runs in list-only CI discovery, When the browse and role-management specs are parsed, Then their scenarios remain discoverable and contain no `test.skip` or `test.fixme` guards except the shared backend-down guard.
quality_gates: `npm --prefix web exec playwright test -- --list us444/02-browse.spec.ts us444/15-role-mgmt.spec.ts`
